rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Basically Finished
card.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

card.title: Basically Finished
card.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the finished budget report. Just the title page: I've left room for contributions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the discussion edition. They can supply their figures directly, without reading mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants a recommendation, not a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add 'Approve' beneath the title. Finished decision edition. We've eliminated the discussion entirely.

card.title: Efficiency Win
card.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's broken. Excellent: stairs replace the gym. Two memberships saved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Eight floors with shopping? We'll need a rest halfway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll leave the bags on four and collect them on our next workout. Built-in weights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The frozen food can't wait for tomorrow's workout.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we train before every meal. Smaller shops, fresher dinners, and the ice cream sets our pace.

card.title: Efficiency Win
card.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

card.title: Fair Exchange
card.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wash up if you do two shopping trips.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two trips for one pan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This pan has dried cheese. Rates have changed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll soak it first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then one trip and the detergent.

card.title: Fair Exchange
card.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Half an hour helping you move buys two hours painting my shed on Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Saturday's my only lie-in. Can I come after lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Afternoon painting costs me cricket. Three hours, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay a painter. You can still go to cricket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A painter covers the shed. Add my match ticket and I'll carry the sofa upstairs.

card.title: Technically, Yes
card.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant all twenty boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

card.title: Technically, Yes
card.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I watered the fern you pointed at. Your holiday watering is done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant every plant, every day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll water every plant through Sunday. That covers your request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave them beside the bath. Water them in it, then put them back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Back beside the bath each day, all watered. Their windowsills weren't part of the arrangement.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll sell the tickets; I'll decide when we draw. One clear chain of command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticket queue is already round the hall. Come help me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll stand beside you and authorise extra ticket sellers. You can start recruiting them.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you make half the sandwiches. I'll write the shopping list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Dictate it while I approve the fillings. Once I've signed it, you can do the shopping.

card.title: Not Dismissed
card.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

card.title: Not Dismissed
card.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Wear this deputy badge and help me decide who gets a hall key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Deputy to the caretaker?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just until the elected committee learns which doors I've opened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not call me co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because the spare keys still answer to my pocket.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The modest caretaker controls access and uses it to recruit a subordinate, not an equal; B's cooperation reveals who directs the work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't mind me, I merely keep the concert lights working. You can be my assistant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The conductor asked me to help them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Tell them our lighting schedule is final.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whose schedule?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ours, in the sense that you'll deliver the one I chose.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The modest caretaker controls access and uses it to recruit a subordinate, not an equal; B's cooperation reveals who directs the work.

card.title: Hidden Power
card.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Plan whatever concert you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll start at eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I unlock the hall at nine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we have a key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Submit your preferred concert time to me.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I need help, not a second direction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does the deputy do?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everything I can confidently delegate.

card.title: Hidden Power
card.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't put me on the committee. I only send the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've voted to invite the whole street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How lovely. I'll send them to the six people I have addresses for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give you the full address list tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Just mark which six you'd most like me to find stamps for.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't equal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first assignment is improving the wording.
